title: Read and Display Name
description: Read a student’s name from standard input (one line) and print `Hello, <name>!`.
instructions: Read a single line of text from stdin.
Trim any trailing newline/spaces and print `Hello, <name>!`.
constraints: Input is a single non-empty line containing a name (1 to 50 chars).
hints: JavaScript: const fs = require("fs"); const name = fs.readFileSync(0, "utf8").trim();
Java: Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); String name = sc.nextLine().trim();
